content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand to GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd., how does the annual leave entitlement change and what is required to carry over unused leave in each location?","answer":"In New Zealand the employee is entitled to a minimum of 4 weeks of annual leave per year, which does not expire and can be accumulated, while in Singapore the entitlement ranges from 7 to 14 days per year depending on tenure and unused leave can only be carried forward with approval.","evidence_a":"- **Minimum:** 4 weeks annual leave per year\n- **Carry over:** Annual leave does not expire and can be accumulated","evidence_b":"- Team members are allowed to carry over unused vacation up to the statutory accrual limit based on tenure.\n- Unused leave requires approval to carry forward"}
